zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_find_hosts
zabbix.description: Resolve technical or display host names to Zabbix host IDs. query searches allowlisted hosts; group_ids lists hosts in those groups; both together search within the groups. At least one is required. Returns every match, including ambiguous matches.

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_get_incident_events
zabbix.description: Retrieve trigger problem events and their recovery events for one host in a bounded time window. Filter by severity; include_recovery controls whether recovery events are paired in.

time_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

time_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_get_trigger_details
zabbix.description: Retrieve a read-only trigger definition, related items, dependencies, tags, and operational description.

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_list_relevant_metrics
zabbix.description: Rank a host's numeric items against supplied keywords by item name and key. Returns item_id, name, key, value type and units for the highest-ranked matches.

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_get_metric_summary
zabbix.description: Aggregate numeric metrics over a window, returning per-series min, max, average, first, last, change percent and trend. Takes up to 20 item_ids and an aggregation interval. The long_term_capacity policy reads trend data and requires an interval of at least 1h. include_points adds aggregated buckets and is disabled by default.

time_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

time_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_get_metric_history
zabbix.description: Retrieve the aggregated points for a single numeric item over a window. Takes one item_id and an optional max_points; exceeding the point limit is an error rather than a silent truncation.

time_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

time_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_get_related_events
zabbix.description: Retrieve neighboring problem and recovery events on the same host, optionally restricted by trigger IDs or exact tags.

time_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

time_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time including Z or an explicit UTC offset

zabbix.name: Zabbix_MCP_Tools_query_zabbix
zabbix.description: Call a Zabbix `.get` method directly with your own parameters and receive the raw API rows. Only `.get` methods are reachable, so nothing here can modify Zabbix. Group-scoped methods have this deployment's host group allowlist intersected into the query; naming a group outside it is an error rather than an empty result. Host-scoped methods require hostids. The reply is capped by row count and by size, and params_applied reports the query as actually sent. Naming fields in `output` reduces the reply. Allowed methods: dashboard.get, event.get, graph.get, host.get, hostgroup.get, hostinterface.get, httptest.get, item.get, problem.get, template.get, trigger.get, usermacro.get.

method.description: Read-only Zabbix API method allowed by this deployment

params.description: Parameters for the method, exactly as the Zabbix API documents them. Set `output` to the fields you actually need. `groupids` is intersected with the allowlist; `limit` is capped.

oss-elastic.name: Elasticsearch_Query_Tools_search
oss-elastic.description: Perform an Elasticsearch search with the provided query DSL.

fields.description: Name of the fields that need to be returned (optional)

index.description: Name of the Elasticsearch index to search

query_body.description: Complete Elasticsearch query DSL object that can include query, size, from, sort, etc.

index_pattern.description: Index pattern of Elasticsearch indices to list

oss-elastic.name: Elasticsearch_Query_Tools_get_mappings
oss-elastic.description: Get field mappings for a specific Elasticsearch index

index.description: Name of the Elasticsearch index to get mappings for

oss-elastic.name: Elasticsearch_Query_Tools_get_shards
oss-elastic.description: Get shard information for all or specific indices.

index.description: Optional index name to get shard information for

wazuh.name: Wazuh_MCP_Tools_get_wazuh_agent_processes
wazuh.description: List the processes running on an agent host: PID, name, state, PPID, user and command. Requires agent_id; optional search (matches name or command) and limit. Reports the host at the time of the call; there is no time parameter.

agent_id.description: Required Wazuh agent ID containing one to three decimal digits.

limit.description: Maximum number of processes to retrieve (default: 300)

search.description: Search string to filter processes by name or command (optional)

wazuh.name: Wazuh_MCP_Tools_get_wazuh_agent_ports
wazuh.description: List network ports on an agent host with local and remote address, protocol, state, owning process and PID. Requires agent_id plus protocol and state values allowed by the input schema; limit is optional. Reports current state and accepts no time parameter.

agent_id.description: Required Wazuh agent ID containing one to three decimal digits.

limit.description: Maximum number of ports to retrieve (default: 300)

wazuh.name: Wazuh_MCP_Tools_get_wazuh_agents
wazuh.description: List the hosts Wazuh has an agent on: id, name, IP, connection status, OS and last activity. Optional filters: status, name, ip, group, os_platform, version, limit. Omitting status returns every agent, including disconnected ones.

ip.description: Agent IP address to filter by (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to retrieve (default: 300)

os_platform.description: Operating system platform to filter by (optional)

status.description: Agent status filter (active, disconnected, pending, never_connected). Omit to cover every status.

wazuh.name: Wazuh_MCP_Tools_get_wazuh_alert_summary
wazuh.description: Search Wazuh alerts in a time window. Each alert returns timestamp, agent, rule level and description, plus the executed command, working directory and user where the alert carries them. Requires time_from and time_to (ISO 8601); optional agent_name, search_term, limit. The reply states how many alerts the window held before filtering, how many matched, and how many were returned.

agent_name.description: Exact Wazuh agent name. Omit to cover every agent.

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (default: 100)

search_term.description: Substring matched against the executed command, the raw log line and the rule description.

time_from.description: Required ISO 8601 date-time at the start of the window.

time_to.description: Required ISO 8601 date-time at the end of the window.
